comparison.objective: Peel a sterile pouch bimanually and transfer forceps onto a sterile drape without contamination, then discard the sheets. Candidate commissions a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires opposed peeling against a seal, controlled no-touch gravity release, contamination-aware transport, and disposal. Candidate requires recessed-tool insertion, counterholding, fine adjustment, controlled tightening, and impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires ≥12 mm peel separation, forceps on the drape, no prohibited contacts, sheets in bins, and arms returned. Candidate requires two safe physical impacts after locking, within energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, overload, and setting-retention limits.
comparison.reason: The record tests aseptic bimanual peeling and no-touch transfer; the candidate tests precision mechanical commissioning and dynamic energy absorption. Their only commonality is bimanual coordination. Candidate rebound, overload, drift tolerance, and witness torque remain unspecified numerically.
